verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk public-data extracts is a fair question for a tax agency, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows interactive lookup tools, such as searching the GST/HST registry or registered charities. These are per-query search interfaces, not bulk downloadable datasets or registry extracts. No evidence of downloadable datasets, statistics files or bulk extracts appears in the pack.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
